inferenceSummary.premise: Adjacent or related passages express positions that Price regards as difficult to reconcile contextually.
inferenceSummary.inference: Layered composition can explain those shifts without supplying missing harmonizing contexts.
inferenceSummary.conclusion: The letters as received may be composite rather than unitary works.

relevanceBurden.rationale: Specific discontinuities materially advance the tradition-development burden without themselves proving interpolation.
relevanceBurden.adjudicationRationale: Specific internal tensions materially advance Price's editorial-development burden, even though they do not independently prove interpolation or composite authorship.
